P_0x00F084:
Director of Intelligence for the <Earth Fed Army>. Holds the rank of lieutenant general. Gilliam Yager's superior. A sharp operator with strong ties to politics and business. Was once an elite special agent.
Gilliam places absolute trust in him, and he in turn recognizes Gilliam's ability. Always courts women he likes with style and finesse. Married once, but lost his wife in an accident.
P_0x00F25B: An upper house member of the <Earth Fed Gov't> parliament. Aqua Centrum's biological father. Serious and doting, prone to worry. Always concerned about Aqua, who ran away from home to join the military.
P_0x00F33D: A member of the <Earth Fed Army>'s 3rd Special Ops <PT> unit "Cry Wolves." Son of Albero Est, the Cry Wolves' captain. Easygoing by nature, and especially close with Hugo.
